name: ALCReplicatedState
summary: The payload carried by state fragment type index 11 (key 16) in the local-player record: the action-list component's replicated state, a group mask then a WIDE PREFIX-VARINT member bitmask over the registered ALC members, then the members it selects. MEASURED SUBSET ONLY: this card models the 28 members the measured 0x9e body sets, out of the 54 the class registers in group 0. The type index resolves through record fn 0x142a3d290 -> facet vtable 0x1480ffd00 -> facet +8 0x142a33830 -> class vtable 0x148100b10 (ctor 0x142a36d50). The class's +0x88 writer 0x142a3f120 and +0x90 reader 0x142a44650 are ALC's OWN pair: the member mask is FUN_14087b910, a wide prefix varint whose integer value's bits select the members (up to 56 bits), NOT the shared 0x1417b5330 seven-bit continuation sequence. An undeclared set bit is refused.
purpose: Name the ALC members the measured local-player ALC body carries, so the fragment is authored from typed values instead of replayed. Because the mask is a prefix-varint bitmask, the schema's member level carries the new `varint` flag.
envelope: Fragment framing only, owned by the bundle/record layer, never a field: the fragment is [varint key][varint type_index][payload] with NO length field, so the payload length is implied by this type. Measured instance: key `16`, type varint `0b` = 11, then 49 payload bytes. Below that, the payload is the two-level presence mask declared by this card's `presence` block: [group mask u8][for each present group: WIDE PREFIX-VARINT member mask][for each present member: that member's body, ascending by member index].
